_readme: Edited by hand. Rendered into marketing HTML at serve time (marketing-content.js); no restart needed. Video values are YouTube video IDs (the part after watch?v=). Case studies: replace the placeholders with real, approved customer data and set placeholder:false. While showPlaceholders is true, placeholder entries are rendered with a visible PLACEHOLDER label and /case-studies is noindex. Set showPlaceholders:false before deploying if no real study is ready.
